text:
maria: FYI CI started failing after I bumped the poetry lock to address the fastapi CVE. Tests are hitting starlette incompat and tokenizers wheel build is erroring. KMS integration smoke tests also blipped. Can security/devex triage and advise rollback vs pin strategy?
rahul: looking now — can you paste the failing logs / error snippet?
maria: ```
ERROR: Could not find a version that satisfies the requirement tokenizers==0.13.3
  No matching distribution found for tokenizers==0.13.3
poetry.lock: 'starlette = "^0.20.4"' causes dependency resolution failure with our asgi matrix
botocore 1.31.0 -> HSM mock failures in kms_emulator tests
```
sam: Probably the fastapi CVE bump pulled in a newer starlette that requires asgiref > 4.x. Quick mitigation: pin starlette to our last-known-good and regen lock with `poetry lock --no-update` for tokenizers until wheel issue resolved.
olivia: KMS failures look like a boto3/botocore minor bump — our local KMS emulator stubs break on botocore 1.31. For now pin botocore to 1.29.x in the lock to keep smoke tests green.
rahul: Prioritization: fastapi CVE is medium-high but CI stability is critical. Proposed plan: 1) revert lockfile commit on main to unblock CI, 2) open PR that pins starlette + botocore + adds tokenizers wheel fallback, 3) run staged regen on dedicated CI and verify, 4) follow-up with proper patch to update tests/emulator for botocore.
infra-bot: Pipeline blocked: wheel build step failed: "ERROR: no matching wheel for tokenizers; building from source failed on macos-latest"
maria: Ack. I'll open the revert PR and include repro steps in the description (local `poetry lock` output + CI logs).
sam: Also suggest adding a quick preflight in CI that checks manylinux wheels availability for binary deps before running long matrix — saves wasted time.
olivia: I'll prepare a minimal KMS-smoke PR that pins botocore and switches the CI smoke to the emulator interface we control (avoids external botocore behavior).
rahul: Timeline: can we unbreak CI within 2 hours? We need to prevent pager fatigue. If not, we should escalate to oncall.
maria: Revert opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-infra/pull/5123 — includes revert + temporary starlette/botocore pins. Triggered a regen run on a smaller matrix. Please review @sam @olivia.
sam: Reviewing now, requested a tiny tox env tweak.
olivia: LGTM from sec. Also adding a follow-up ticket to harden KMS emulator and add unit tests for botocore upgrade cases.
maria: Thanks all — will merge once CI goes green and then we can plan the proper upgrade path. :thumbsup:
